name: natural-farsi
title_zh: 波斯语文本先查半空格再谈翻译的校对器
tagline_zh: 写波斯语总被说“像机器翻译”？它专治半角空格和变音符号，还管 RTL/LTR 混排，让 README。
tagline_en: Write Farsi that reads human-typed: no half-spaces, no diacritics, natural tone, and correct handling of mixed.
desc_en: How to write natural, informal Persian (Farsi) like a real person typing — the "no half-space, no diacritics" orthography, plus conversational tone, plus correct handling of mixed Persian/technical (RTL/LTR) content. Use this skill whenever writing, editing, or translating anything into Farsi: READMEs, docs, UI strings, commit descriptions, chat replies, social posts, or emails — even when the use
why_zh: 它不教语法，而是盯住波斯语书写的隐形规则：去掉半空格、去掉变音符号、保持口语化语气。
why_en: Targets orthographic rules most tools miss: half-space removal, diacritic stripping, conversational tone, and proper RTL/LTR.
limit_zh: 只针对波斯语书写规范，不涉及词汇选择或语法纠错；需要输入文本本身已基本正确；对阿拉伯语或其他 RTL 语言无效。
limit_en: Only for Persian orthography, not grammar or word choice; input must be basically correct; not for Arabic or other RTL scripts.
title_en: Persian text checker for half-spaces, diacritics & RTL/LTR.
